explain.say: If one baby were born today in Tokyo and another in Lagos, how long might each one live? The answer is a big clue to how developed a country is. Look at the board. The bars show life expectancy, which means how many years a newborn baby can expect to live, on average.

explain.say: Look at Nigeria, at about 54 years. That does not mean most people die at 54. It is an average, pulled down because many young children die from diseases like malaria and from unsafe water. Can you see how saving children changes the whole average?

faq.a: Life expectancy is the average number of years a newborn baby would live if today’s rates of death stayed the same. It is one of the best clues to a country’s health and development.

faq.q: Why do people in Japan live so long?
faq.a: Japanese people eat a healthy diet with fish, vegetables and small portions, stay active, and everyone has health care. Japan’s life expectancy, about 84 years, is among the highest in the world.
asks: Which country has the longest life expectancy?

faq.q: Why is life expectancy low in some countries?
faq.a: Mostly because many young children die from malaria, diarrhoea and pneumonia, linked to unsafe water, few doctors and poverty. Wars and conflict also lower it.
asks: Why do children die young in poor countries?

faq.a: Development means how good life is for people in a country: their health, education, income and freedom. Geographers measure it with indicators such as income per person, life expectancy and literacy.

faq.q: What is the Human Development Index?
faq.a: The Human Development Index, or HDI, is a United Nations score from 0 to 1 that combines life expectancy, years of schooling and income per person. Higher means more developed.

facts: World life expectancy rose from about 46 years in 1950 to about 73 years in 2023 (UN).
Japan's life expectancy, about 84 years, is among the highest in the world.
The United Nations has published the Human Development Index since 1990.
